meta.name: Bass X Machina
meta.description: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

videos.title: Until Then...I'm Bass Reeves
videos.overview: The US Army summons bounty hunter Bass Reeves to Fort Hope to hire him for one last job: retrieve a missing scientist — and stop a second Civil War.

videos.title: A Good Way to Catch a Bullet
videos.overview: Now saddled with an unexpected sidekick, Bass rides into the Badlands to find Bully Shaw and reconnects with an old friend.

videos.title: That Don't Look Like God
videos.overview: An electrifying clash with the Holy People leaves Bass in shock and in need of repair. Dana learns the truth about Bass' traumatic past.

videos.title: This Train's Being Integrated
videos.overview: Tensions boil over on the train to Tuskaheegee, stirring core memories from Dana's childhood and pulling Bass into a fateful confrontation.

videos.title: I Do What I Have to Do to Survive
videos.overview: Bass begs Ahni to let go of her anger as crowds gather in the City of Tomorrow, where General Rivenbark unveils the ultimate weapon.

videos.title: If You Want a Country, You Have to Kill for It
videos.overview: With innocent lives on the line, the Colossus takes the fight to Central City — with Bass and his God Arm close behind.
